ex-augŭro , āvi, ātum, 1, v. a.,
I.to apply to profane uses a thing which has been consecrated, to desecrate, profane (very rare): fana, Cato ap. Fest. s. v. NEQVITVM, p. 162, 32 Müll.; cf. Liv. 1, 55: “vestalem,” Gell. 6, 7, 14 : “sacerdotes,” Capitol. M. Aurel. 4 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
